public_rationale: The descriptive core is well documented: models generated recognisable reference formats containing invented works, and ChatGPT-generated fake cases reached court. OpenScholar also supports the practical value of grounding and feedback. These findings are consistent with Marcus's explanation, but they do not establish that structural imitation without verification is the shared cause across both settings. The causal proposition therefore remains unresolved; the fabrication problem itself does not.
limitations: Successful mitigation is evidence about contributors, but a combined system change does not isolate every causal component.
The evidence does not justify a universal claim that all LLM systems lack verification.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Fake citations and faked legal cases from LLMs stem from the same problem of mimicking structure without sanity-checking against available information.

statement.excerpt: The chronic problem with creating fake citations in research papers and faked cases in legal briefs is a manifestation of the same problem; LLMs correctly “model” the structure of academic references, but often make up titles, page numbers, journals and so on — once again failing to sanity check their outputs against information (in this case lists of references) that are readily found on the internet.

our_interpretation: Read this as a causal explanation: generating plausible reference structures without dependable verification materially produces fabricated scholarly and legal citations.
The claim does not require identical neural circuits in every model or assert that verification failure is the only contributing cause.
Separate the documented occurrence of fabricated references from evidence establishing the proposed shared cause.
criteria.support_condition: Studies establish plausible but fabricated references and show that generation without source verification materially causes such errors in both scholarly and legal settings, consistent with the proposed structural-imitation mechanism.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Relevant controlled studies show that the proposed mechanism does not materially explain the fabrications, or establish incompatible causes for the claimed shared explanation.
